regime: full; capability-segregated without strong host isolation
scope: Bilateral language parity against pinned vanilla for required corpus, inventories and exporters; no byte-level or unenumerated whole-language claim.

baseline.identity: Unknown: bytes pinned, association to a51e02804 not independently proved; blocks PARIDADE DEMONSTRADA until resolved.

obligations: O01 Same frozen sources, assets, features, timestamp, jobs, options, fonts, locale and environment on both sides; record commands, exits, diagnostics, artifact/tool/binary hashes, HEAD, tree, and time.
O02 Classify every required observable separately at semantics, syntax or morphology; bytes/mechanics gate only when publicly observable.
O03 Execute complete standard and HTML inventories and all minimum cases, with no missing, duplicate, stale or unclassified row.
O04 Malformed output, unsupported parser, missing dependency, unilateral observation, ambiguous identity, budget or harness/provenance failure is Unknown, never success.
O05 Repeat forward and reverse; classifications and canonical observable digests must agree.
O06 Reject every valid semantic mutation before seal: mutation_score=1.0; deliberate opacity remains Unknown.
O07 Verify protected hashes before/after every phase; drift invalidates downstream evidence.
O08 Emit exactly one global verdict; test/path/format/pixel counts are not a language-parity percentage.

classifications.Preserved: Valid bilateral observation with adequate provenance and harness is equivalent in declared language semantics, syntax and morphology.
classifications.Violated: Reproducible provenance-valid bilateral witness differs at language level, including a public diagnostic when it is the observable.
classifications.Unknown: Identity, fixture, parser, dependency, bilateral execution, provenance, coverage or budget prevents decision; Unknown is never success.
classifications.NotApplicable: Predeclared observable is structurally irrelevant; it cannot hide a required capability and never counts as Preserved.
classifications.case_fold: Violated if any required observable is Violated; else Unknown if any is Unknown; else Preserved if all are Preserved/justified NotApplicable and at least one is Preserved; otherwise NotApplicable.
classifications.guards: Malformed vanilla is Unknown even if reproduced; Available/BaselineOnly never implies Preserved.

minimum_corpus.C08: raster, SVG/SVGZ, opaque/unsupported images and dependencies
minimum_corpus.C09: linear/radial/conic/tiling gradients in required color spaces

minimum_exporters.E02: PDF plain timestamp 0; text, boxes, font and accessibility axes separate
minimum_exporters.E05: SVG Conic separately per supported color space
minimum_exporters.E07: SVG/bundle same-page, cross-page and cross-file links
minimum_exporters.E09: SVG glyph collisions, missing font, fontless wrapper
minimum_exporters.E10: SVG alpha, masks, nested clip, even-odd

png_focal_tolerance.default: Exact decoded RGBA; no general pixel, percent, channel, SSIM, geometry or antialias tolerance.
png_focal_tolerance.rule: Before candidate comparison, an independent oracle author freezes a SHA-pinned mask of <=11 coordinates, vanilla and allowed candidate RGBA per coordinate, and a root-cause witness proving rasterizer-edge variation rather than language morphology. Both images must be 1191x1684 RGBA, all non-raster observables Preserved, every difference in-mask matching its allowed pair, and zero outside. Otherwise exact equality applies.
png_focal_tolerance.non_generalization: Never transfers to another fixture/PPI/size/exporter/global claim or excuses geometry, content, order, color-role or alpha changes.

coverage_sufficient: All C01-C12 and E01-E11 run bilaterally with frozen fixtures/tools; standard and HTML inventories are complete.
Every required observable has a witness and none is Unknown; NotApplicable is justified and removes no required capability.
Forward/reverse agree, protected hashes stay fixed, mutation_score=1.0. This checklist, never a percentage, defines sufficiency.
global_verdict: 1 If >=1 provenance-valid reproducible language Violated exists: PARIDADE PARCIAL; list all known differences and remaining Unknown.
2 Else if zero language Violated, coverage is sufficient, baseline identity is proved and no decision-critical harness/provenance defect exists: PARIDADE DEMONSTRADA with limits.
3 Else: INCONCLUSIVO; identify the harness, coverage, identity or provenance blocker. Exactly one verdict; green focal matrix alone never proves parity.

roles.contract_author: Reads pinned inputs; writes manifest/receipt only; no candidate/L0/tests/oracles/baselines/attacks/verdict.
roles.oracle_author: Reads frozen manifest/receipt/spec/baseline/fixtures; freezes oracles before candidate access; no contract/verdict.
roles.adversary: Reads frozen contract/baseline/oracles; writes attacks/receipt; no fixes/contract/verdict.
roles.implementer: Reads sealed contract/authorized L0; writes candidate/tests; no contract/baseline/oracle/attack/verdict.
roles.verifier: Reads frozen artifacts/outputs; writes receipt/certificate only; cannot correct verified material.

freeze: No oracle author may begin until p1287-contract-receipt.md records this SHA-256. Any byte change invalidates downstream oracle, attack, seal, candidate and verdict.
